Independent #789 correction review: APPROVED for source at 86968e3339fe1c9339c81b6f4c6b01aebe519978 against 4e534f88. No concrete blocking findings in this bounded diff. This is fresh diff approval, not the earlier research approval or installed acceptance.

Reviewed in clean isolated detached worktree /Users/jku/git/c-compiler-review-86968e33. Author worktree untouched. Reviewer thread 01a09ecd-a80c-78e3-b4da-c443469da62a; codex/gpt-6-astra metadata verified earlier in this review session. Canonical repository rules/principles/epic and Small AGENTS/UI contract were read in full earlier and retained for this review.

Source conclusions:
- os/win32/user32.c:6879 validates placement length before side effects, retains geometry handling, and applies showCmd independently of geometry changes through ShowWindow. Normal versus nonactivating show uses the existing shared activation policy. This does not establish full native minimize/maximize/placement compatibility; those existing veneer limitations remain.
- os/win32/user32.c:1987 gates keyboard routing on top visibility before menu handling; :1996 retains enabled-ancestry checks while allowing an explicitly focused hidden child. This is supported by the specific Oracle/OpenJDK native focus-proxy evidence and Wine hidden-edit conformance source documented in logs/2026-09-14/789-corrections.md. Microsoft generic visibility wording remains in tension; no native Windows execution is claimed. Mouse visibility policy is unchanged.
- vendor/sameboy/src/main.c:678 and os/gpubox.c:541 explicitly show after initialization rather than undoing hidden creation semantics.
- kernel.js:7429 and os/wm_proto.h:285 add VIEWABLE=512 without changing the record layout or existing bit meanings. It excludes unmapped, minimized, requested-hidden and suppressed anchored descendants. It does not promise unoccluded pixels or a submitted frame.
- os/wmctl.c:434, :504 and :540 consistently enlarge flag buffers, add the visible predicate and accept its one-argument wait syntax. Startup checks now require viewability. Existing list field positions remain intact.
- The correction log accurately distinguishes synthetic-state/nonboot tests, retained author baseline-red evidence, historical screenshots and outstanding gates; image version 293 is not claimed installed.

Reviewer-executed, all PASS at the exact SHA:
1. node tests/kernel/test_user32_lifecycle_policy.js: 10 actual-user32 synthetic-state checks and six actual-wmctl compiled query checks.
2. node tests/kernel/test_wm_lifecycle.js: 44 fake-worker lifecycle assertions.
3. node tests/kernel/test_wm_lifecycle_policy.js: eight compiled actual-wm.c event-policy checks.
4. git diff 4e534f88 HEAD --check; detached tree remained clean.

Nonblocking coverage limits: the new User32 focus probe exercises key-down, not key-up/TranslateMessage or hidden-top menu routing with an open menu. The wmctl probe exercises the predicate and flags, not do_wait CLI parsing/poll transport. Public creation, application startup and installed rendering remain for the separately scheduled gates. The retained baseline-red log was inspected, not independently rerun.

No boot, bake, browser, heavy gate, source edit, main merge, push or deployment performed. Dispatcher 86785 retains its slot; this approval neither waives acceptance nor completes the rollout.

Independent #789 exact-tip source review: APPROVED c8e726341acc58ea07c6296126b94ac98d2cc350, sole parent approved 86968e3339fe1c9339c81b6f4c6b01aebe519978. No findings.

Verified clean author tree read-only and complete parent-to-tip diff: only tests/kernel/test_wm_service_e2e.js:941 changes the tab-delimited literal FLAGS expectation from f---R--- to f---R----, with an H-clear comment. This matches os/wmctl.c:434-447, whose ninth flag is H only for application-hidden surfaces. The assertion still checks the complete field including its trailing tab; it is not weakened to a prefix check. Runtime and image bytes are unchanged.

Reviewer executed node --check tests/kernel/test_wm_service_e2e.js and git diff 86968e33 HEAD --check; both passed. Inspected author standard-flake-v1.log: kernel 9 passed/3 failed and browser 18 passed/0 failed. Retained WM-service repetition logs show the stale focused/resizable assertion against the nine-character row. These are author-run evidence, not reviewer gate execution.

No boot, browser, bake, heavy tests, source edits, merge, push or deployment. Approval is for this test-only delta; author still owns the slot and corrected standard-flake rerun. Whole rollout remains incomplete.
